items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Your second wife was Barbara. INTERVIEWEE: My first wife was Jean.

ctx.x: Yeah, I guess you have to read a book to know what we're talking about. They could always write a book.
Sure, right, buy the book. I recommend it entirely, called Beneath the Underdog by Charles Mingus, Jr. Did you ever see -- your first wife was named Barbara, wasn't it?
